rows.name: Project 26 Pennsylvania

rows.name: Propel Capital Network

rows.name: Rebuild Usa

rows.name: Republican Jewish Coalition

rows.name: Republican State Leadership Committee
rows.description: RSLC is the largest organization of Republican state leaders and works to recruit, train, and elect Republicans to down-ballot state offices in all 50 states.

rows.name: Restoration Of America
rows.description: 501(c)(4) conservative advocacy group defending America by electing leaders who support transparent elections, economic freedom, limited government, military superiority, secure borders, rule of law and sanctity of life, opposing Marxist neo-liberal and Communist China threats, grounded in God and just laws.

rows.name: Rob Bonta For Ca Attorney General 2026

rows.name: Rooney Holdings, Inc.

rows.name: Safari Club International
rows.description: Leader in defending the freedom to hunt and promoting wildlife conservation worldwide for over 50 years. SCI is unique in the scope of our ability to defend and advance our freedom to hunt. SCI is the only hunting rights organization with a Washington, D.C. based national and international advocacy team and an all-species focus.

rows.name: Santa Rosa Rancheria
rows.description: The Santa Rosa Rancheria Tachi Yokut Tribe preserves and promotes the cultural heritage of the Yokuts people of the San Joaquin Valley. They focus on educating others about their history, traditions, language, and sacred sites while protecting ancestral lands for future generations.

rows.name: San Manuel Band Of Mission Indians
rows.description: The Yuhaaviatam of San Manuel Nation (formerly San Manuel Band of Mission Indians) is a federally recognized American Indian tribe and sovereign nation. Guided by self-sufficient government, it preserves cultural identity, upholds sovereignty, and builds resilience through growth, unity, and community support.
rows.quote: The Yuhaaviatam of San Manuel Nation is a federally recognized American Indian tribe and sovereign nation. Guided by our self-sufficient government, we preserve our cultural identity while navigating a modern path forward. Our sovereignty is the foundation of our resilience, allowing us to uphold the rights and responsibilities that ensure the legacy of our ancestors continues to thrive.

rows.name: San Pablo Lytton Casino
rows.description: San Pablo Lytton Casino is owned and operated by the Lytton Band of Pomo Indians. It started as a card room and has grown into a full casino offering over 1,500 Class II gaming machines in a smoke-free environment with dining options.

rows.name: Sapphire Strategies

rows.quote: Sapphire helps Democratic campaigns raise money, reach voters, respond quickly, and keep the work moving with sharper lists, cleaner follow-up, and clearer accountability.

SECURING AMERICAN GREATNESS SERVES TO ENSURE CONSERVATIVE POLICIES ARE CHAMPIONED ACROSS AMERICA

SECURE BORDERS
SAFE COMMUNITIES
LOW TAXES
STRONG NATIONAL DEFENSE

OUR ORGANIZATION AIMS TO EDUCATE VOTERS, WHILE ENGAGING ALL AMERICANS ALIGNED WITH A CONSERVATIVE AGENDA THROUGH VOTER REGISTRATION.

rows.name: Seiu Virginia
rows.description: The SEIU Virginia State Council unites SEIU members and not-yet-union workers to build power, win economic/racial/immigrant justice, fight for good union jobs, and make Virginia the best state for working people.
rows.quote: The SEIU Virginia State Council unites union members and not-yet-union workers to build power and win economic, racial, and immigrant justice for workers, our families, and our communities across the commonwealth.

rows.name: Silencer Shop

rows.name: Sixteen Thirty Fund

rows.description: South Point Hotel, Casino & Spa is a full-service Las Vegas resort offering spacious rooms and suites, a large casino with slots, table games, sports/race books, poker and bingo, plus dining, entertainment, bowling, movies, spa, and a premier equestrian center.

rows.name: Spirit Of 1776

rows.name: Teamsters Local 705 Pac
rows.description: Teamsters Local 705 proudly represents about 17,000 members in the Chicago area and Midwest, covering UPS, freight, warehousing, public works and other sectors. rows.quote: Teamsters Local 705 proudly represents about 17,000 members in and around the Chicago land area. Today, under the leadership of Secretary-Treasurer Juan Campos, and the Executive Board, Local 705 represents UPS, Freight, Cartage, Warehousing, Public Works, Rail Yards, Movers and thousands of other members in the Midwest.

rows.name: Texas Organizing Project
rows.description: The Texas Organizing Project (TOP), founded in 2009, organizes Black and Latino communities in Dallas, Harris and Bexar counties to transform Texas so working people of color have power and representation. It runs issue-based campaigns and electoral organizing to build grassroots power.
rows.quote: The Texas Organizing Project (TOP), founded in 2009, organizes Black and Latino communities in Dallas, Harris and Bexar counties with the goal of transforming Texas into a state where working people of color have the power and representation they deserve.

rows.name: The Chickasaw Nation
rows.description: The Chickasaw Nation is a sovereign tribal government dedicated to enhancing the quality of life for its citizens through economic development, cultural preservation, self-sufficiency, and a wide range of programs and services in health, education, housing, and more.
rows.quote: Today, the Chickasaw Nation is economically strong, culturally vibrant and full of energetic people dedicated to the preservation of family, community and heritage.

rows.name: The International Union Of Bricklayers & Allied Craftworkers
rows.description: Since its founding in 1865, the International Union of Bricklayers and Allied Craftworkers has fought to improve members’ quality of life through fair wages, good benefits, safe working conditions, and solidarity. It represents highly skilled trowel trades craftworkers across the US and Canada and is the oldest continuous union in North America.
rows.quote: Since its founding in 1865, the International Union of Bricklayers and Allied Craftworkers has actively fought to improve our members’ quality of life – on and off the job – through access to fair wages, good benefits, safe working conditions, and solidarity among members.

rows.name: The Lytton Rancheria Of California
rows.description: The Lytton Rancheria of California is a federally recognized tribe whose ancestral lands span the northern San Francisco Bay Area to the Russian River Valley. It emphasizes restoring sovereignty, building economic independence through enterprises like gaming and viticulture, developing a tribal homeland with housing, and supporting community services including education and healthcare.

rows.name: The Vestcor Companies Inc.

rows.quote: We are real-estate professionals developing quality multifamily housing communities. We value integrity, creativity, and the entrepreneurial spirit.

rows.name: The Welcome Party, Inc.
rows.description: The Welcome Party is a 501(c)(4) launched in Fall 2019 to engage less ideological, less partisan swing voters and conduct research demonstrating why a big-tent Democratic Party is both a reality and a necessity, focusing on nonpartisan education and advocacy on democracy issues.

rows.name: Transport Workers Union Of America
rows.description: The Transport Workers Union of America, AFL-CIO represents more than 160,000 members across airline, railroad, transit, university, utility and service sectors. Members include mechanics, flight attendants, bus operators and more; on the front lines moving the economy since 1934.
rows.quote: We are mechanics, car cleaners, baggage handlers, disease control inspectors, bus operators, ramp agents, flight attendants, and more—and we are on the front lines of moving the American economy forward, keeping the traveling public safe and offering working people a voice on the job since 1934.

rows.name: Uaw V Cap
rows.description: UAW V-CAP is the UAW’s voluntary political action fund and independent PAC. It collects voluntary member contributions (separate from dues) to support pro-labor candidates and make political expenditures in federal, state, and local elections.
rows.quote: Note: UAW V-CAP is an independent political action committee created by the UAW. This committee does not ask for or accept authorization from any candidate, and no candidate is responsible for its activities. UAW V-CAP uses the money it receives to make political contributions and expenditures in connection with federal, state and local elections. Contributions to UAW V-CAP are purely voluntary...

rows.name: United States Postal Service
rows.description: The U.S. Postal Service is an independent establishment of the executive branch providing universal mail and package delivery to every U.S. address. It reaches nearly 167 million residences, businesses and P.O. boxes, generally receives no tax dollars, and is funded by postage, products and services.
rows.quote: The U.S. Postal Service is the only delivery service that reaches every address in the nation: Nearly 167 million residences, businesses and Post Office Boxes. The Postal Service generally receives no tax dollars for operating expenses and relies on the sale of postage, products and services to fund its operations.

rows.name: United Steelworkers
rows.description: The USW is a labor union representing workers in manufacturing, mining, healthcare, energy, and many other industries. It emphasizes collective bargaining for wages, benefits and safety, gives members a voice on the job, and advocates for key labor laws.
rows.quote: By working together, we bargain strong contracts that raise wages, strengthen benefits and advance workplace health and safety. We give workers across a wide spectrum of industries a voice on the job, and our advocacy has helped bring about some of the most important labor laws. And we’re not done yet.

rows.name: United We Dream Action Pac
rows.description: United We Dream Action (UWDA) is the lobbying, advocacy and electoral arm of United We Dream, powered by immigrant youth, youth of color with immigrant family members, and everyday voters. rows.quote: United We Dream Action (UWDA) is the lobbying, advocacy and electoral arm of United We Dream which is powered by immigrant youth, youth of color with immigrant family members, and everyday voters.

rows.name: Unite Here

rows.name: Unite Here Action Fund

rows.quote: The purpose of UNITE HERE Action Fund is to assist hospitality workers and their families to achieve economic, social, and racial justice in workplaces and communities through education and advocacy, leadership development, and promoting full participation in civic life.

rows.name: Yocha Dehe Wintun Nation
rows.description: Yocha Dehe Wintun Nation is a self-governed sovereign nation in California's Capay Valley, dedicated to preserving Patwin language, culture, and sacred sites while stewarding ancestral lands and building economic security through enterprises and community investment.
rows.quote: Yocha Dehe is a self-governed, sovereign nation that supports its Citizens. Because we have not forgotten our own years of struggle, we invest significant resources to benefit the community, state and nation, including Indian country generally.
